title: <ClearAll/> and <CurrentRefinements/> are not well handled with default refinements
body:
![bug-clear-all](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6885378/21801869/c8251858-d723-11e6-9266-fc22af5aea0a.gif)

![bug-clear-all-2](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6885378/21801868/c82150b0-d723-11e6-91a0-3604e540b7cc.gif)

Will be fix as:

* Still display default refinement in the `<CurrentRefinements/>` widget. If a user don't want to display them he will be able to use the new `transformItems` props to filter them.
